blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–After winning its first gold medal, Team Philippines looks to add to its medal haul as action continues in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Friday, September 25. Carlos Yulo and Eldrew Yulo return to competition with more medals at stake on the final day of men’s artistic gymnastics, while the Philippines’ skateboarding bets aim for the podium in the park event. The Philippines also makes its final push for a swimming medal on the last day of competition while Gilas Pilipinas teams shoot for finals berths in […]...
